import numpy as np
from cadverify.cadcheck.mesh import load_exact
from cadverify.cadcheck import section
from cadverify.cadcheck.assembly import _poses, _box_gap, overlap
w = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
b = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.57cfb177.stl')
names = {'wheel1': {'name':'wheel1','_mesh':w,'_solid':section.to_manifold(w)}, 'base1': {'name':'base1','_mesh':b,'_solid':section.to_manifold(b)}}
motion = {'name':'free','kind':'rotate','point':[0,0,4],'axis':[0,0,1],'range':[0,-30],'instances':['wheel1']}
rest = {n: (names[n]['_solid'], np.reshape(names[n]['_solid'].bounding_box(),(2,3))) for n in ['wheel1','base1']}
mats=_poses(motion,-17.0)
print('matrix:'); print(mats['wheel1'])
solid=rest['wheel1'][0].transform(mats['wheel1'][:3])
print('solid vol', solid.volume(), 'bbox', np.reshape(solid.bounding_box(),(2,3)))
other=rest['base1'][0]
print('overlap', overlap(solid, other))
"
